problems.evidence: tests/test_board_claim_scan.py; in daily use on the team board since 2026-10-09
problems.problem: Concurrent-work claim collisions: two seats claiming or building the same work at the same time (duplicate repairs, double Smart-Note claims, parallel identical PRs). Solved by scanning open PRs plus the team board's newest comments for keyword overlap BEFORE building, with a collision verdict that stops the build until the seats coordinate and consolidate.

Engineering excellence enforcement at PR time: every change must test the seam it touches, add no dead code, stay minimal, cite evidence not confidence, and introduce no duplicate systems. Solved by a five-gate mechanical checker, including the no-duplicate-systems gate that fails new symbols which duplicate existing seams by name or near-name.

Brain index drift: the regenerable derived views of the NayaPOWER brain drifting from their basis commit. Solved by a single regenerator whose basis commit is anchored to the live main tip and whose --check mode compares against the correct basis, with a basis-pointer quirk fix for stale origin/main refs in fetched worktrees.

Smart Note capture pipeline: turning durable intelligence into structured, classified, provenance-carrying notes instead of raw text. Solved by the v2 capture/validate/classify pipeline with machine schema, adversarial qualification (25/25), and registry-drift tests.

Proof of receipt for captured intelligence: distinguishing 'a note was received, saved, and stamped' from 'the lesson was learned'. Solved by the Smart Link coat-check ticket — a receipt token that proves capture only, never learning.

Cold activation acceptance: a cold Naya is not activated merely because it can read files. Solved by the one-breath activation gate that checks the agent can reconstruct identity, director, authority, system, architecture, verification state, unknowns, current reality, and exactly one next action.

Decision math: one canonical way to score material choices (objective, evidence, effect, risk, blast radius, reversibility, cost of inaction, net value, authority) instead of every seat inventing its own scorecard. Solved by the versioned Decision Value Calculus and its recalibration schema.

Learning promotion proof: a captured lesson is not a learned lesson. Solved by the learning evidence ladder — a behavioral proof ladder that promotes a lesson only when it measurably changes behavior on a held-out task, with control/treatment arms and an adversarial wrong-memory arm for high-value claims.

Multi-node liveness and guaranteed progress: proving the work actually completes, not just that nothing wrong happened. Solved by the canonical liveness seam with deadlock detection over the live wait graph, livelock detection (activity without obligation reduction), starvation detection (eligible work unserved while other work progresses), genuine-progress classification (heartbeats, log lines, retries, status rewrites are not progress), waiting-state honesty (WAITING_AUTHORITY only leaves via a real authorization, never reclassified as completed), and the hard rule that liveness never creates permission across an authority boundary.

problems.problem: Well-founded measure of real progress: activity is not progress — only a verified reduction in outstanding obligations counts. Solved by the canonical progress seam with two non-gameable measures (proof progress: a required obligation independently discharged with acceptable evidence; termination progress: movement toward a finite resolution including bounded failure recovery), budgets bound to the obligation rather than the agent, no invented progress, and escalation never completing the original objective.

problems.problem: Fair scheduling without false progress: fairness guarantees opportunity, execution creates observations, and only qualifying evidence proves progress — three separate proofs composing into one liveness claim. Solved by the canonical fairness seam with FairnessContract, SchedulingEvent adequacy checks, FairnessLedger, and no-debt-reset plus service-not-assertion checks.
problems.evidence: On main at 57e935c1; 483 lines SPEC + deterministic machinery (FairnessContract, FairnessLedger, check_no_debt_reset); CODE-ONLY — extend this seam, do not rebuild it elsewhere. D24 directive (#1354).

problems.problem: Strong fairness where weak fairness is not enough: weak fairness protects work that stays eligible; strong fairness prevents starvation of work that flickers in and out of eligibility. Solved by the canonical strong-fairness seam with the situation-to-standard recommender, explicit assumption checks, three-sub-proof composition into strong termination, and the FlickerLedger duty-owed computation.
problems.evidence: On main at 57e935c1; 548 lines SPEC + deterministic machinery (recommend_standard, ThreeSubProofs, FlickerLedger); CODE-ONLY — extend this seam, do not rebuild it elsewhere. D25 directive (#1354).

problems.problem: Fairness verification by proving the three links separately: every liveness qualification must independently establish opportunity, fair service, and verified progress — component success plus component success is not system success unless the interactions are proven. Solved by the canonical fairness-verification seam with lasso classification over obligation observations (cycle enabled/serviced patterns, rank decrease, terminal states, awaiting-authority).

purpose: Operating Code V2 — Gate 7 (Duplicate Detector). Machine-readable list of problems already solved at 10 and FROZEN. Before building anything new, run tools/duplicate_detector.py against this registry. A FLAG means the problem is already solved at the canonical location: consolidate or extend that seam — never rebuild. The flag is mandatory; the human director decides the consolidation.
seed_note: Seeded 2026-10-10 by Gate 7 construction. The 'frozen' date on seed entries is the date the entry was verified into this registry: the repo checkout is shallow so original authorship dates are unrecoverable. Canonical paths were verified present at live main tip. A seat claiming an earlier freeze date should attach the evidence (merged PR / test receipt) to that entry.
